Conclusions The study was conducted to analyze the demands of linear operation in the process of cotton ﬁeld management. Through the method of crop row recognition and path plan- ning based on the Census transform, the pure tracking model and the incremental PID control algorithm, a tractor path tracking control system based on binocular vision was devel- oped. The recognition method of the crop line based on the Census transform was found to realize Census transform.
